1.w: For the music director, a psalm of David. O Lord , the king rejoices in the strength you give; he takes great delight in the deliverance you provide.

2.w: You grant him his heart’s desire; you do not refuse his request. (Selah)

3.w: For you bring him rich blessings; you place a golden crown on his head.

4.w: He asked you to sustain his life, and you have granted him long life and an enduring dynasty.

5.w: Your deliverance brings him great honor; you give him majestic splendor.

6.w: For you grant him lasting blessings; you give him great joy by allowing him into your presence.

7.w: For the king trusts in the Lord , and because of the Most High’s faithfulness he is not shaken.

8.w: You prevail over all your enemies; your power is too great for those who hate you.

9.w: You burn them up like a fiery furnace when you appear. The Lord angrily devours them; the fire consumes them.

10.w: You destroy their offspring from the earth, their descendants from among the human race.

11.w: Yes, they intend to do you harm; they dream up a scheme, but they do not succeed.

12.w: For you make them retreat when you aim your arrows at them.

13.w: Rise up, O Lord , in strength! We will sing and praise your power.
